points.description: Mentions abstraction (অ্যাবস্ট্রাকশন) as a main advantage of object-oriented programming. Accept equivalent wording such as 'hiding implementation details' or 'showing only essential features' when clearly presented as an OOP advantage.

Mentions reusability (পুনঃব্যবহারযোগ্যতা) as a main advantage of object-oriented programming. Accept equivalent wording such as 'code can be reused' or 'reusing existing code/classes' when clearly presented as an OOP advantage.

rubric.notes: Full marks require naming both abstraction and reusability as advantages of OOP. A student who gives only one of these correct advantages earns 2.5 marks. Advantages not matching the model answer (e.g. only 'inheritance' or 'polymorphism' without linking to abstraction/reusability) do not earn these points.
